resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the team that wins the 2026 MLB World Series. 

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed team to win the 2026 MLB World Series per the rules of MLB (e.g., they are eliminated in the playoffs), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the 2026 MLB season is cancelled, postponed after December 31, 2026 ET, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from MLB (https://www.mlb.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

# Cleveland Guardians: 2026 World Series research brief (as of 2026-10-17 close)

## 1. Resolution source
- MLB.com is the stated resolution source. I did not fetch a postseason bracket snapshot dated on or before the close, so the status below comes from game reports. [MLB Guardians news](https://www.mlb.com/guardians/news)
- I could not find an official MLB standings page with a date stamp from before the close.

## 2. Current status (as of the 2026-10-17 06:07 UTC close)
- Nothing has settled the question yet. Cleveland is alive in the ALCS and leads Tampa Bay 2-1 in a best-of-seven series.
- The Milwaukee Brewers swept the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NLCS. That makes Milwaukee the likely World Series opponent for whoever wins the ALCS. [SI](https://www.si.com/betting/world-series-odds-brewers-set-as-odds-on-favorites-after-sweeping-dodgers-01m52kz736d4)
- To win, Cleveland needs 2 more ALCS wins and then 4 World Series wins.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-16/17: Rain postponed ALCS Game 4 (Rays at Guardians, Progressive Field) on Friday night. It was moved to Saturday, Oct 17. Game 5 is set for Sunday in Cleveland, and Game 6, if needed, for Monday in St. Petersburg. [MySuncoast](https://www.mysuncoast.com/2026/10/17/alcs-game-4-postponed-by-rain-rays-guardians-resume-series-saturday/), [MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/guardians/news/when-is-rays-vs-guardians-alcs-game-4-date-time-and-lineups)
- 2026-10-15: Cleveland beat Tampa Bay 3-2 in Game 3 for a 2-1 series lead. Petey Halpin hit a go-ahead two-run homer in the 5th. Gavin Williams struck out 9 over 5 innings, and Cade Smith got the final 4 outs. Rays hitters struck out 13 times. [AP via ADN](https://www.adn.com/sports/national-sports/2026/10/15/halpins-go-ahead-homer-flips-game-3-as-guardians-beat-rays-3-2-for-2-1-alcs-lead/), [Cleveland19](https://www.cleveland19.com/2026/10/15/guardians-hold-off-rays-grab-game-3/)
- Before Game 3: the teams split Games 1 and 2. [FOX Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/articles/mlb/guardians-and-rays-tied-11-ahead-of-alcs-game-3)
- Earlier in October: Cleveland got through the ALDS against the Chicago White Sox after avoiding elimination at one point (per later summaries).

## 4. Base rates
- Teams leading an LCS 2-1 have gone on to the World Series 70.3% of the time. This is only the fourth time Cleveland has led an ALCS 2-1. [AP via ADN](https://www.adn.com/sports/national-sports/2026/10/15/halpins-go-ahead-homer-flips-game-3-as-guardians-beat-rays-3-2-for-2-1-alcs-lead/)
- World Series winners: AL and NL pennant winners have historically split close to 50/50. The team with home-field or the better record wins only a little more often than not.
- Cleveland's last title was in 1948, and it lost the World Series in 1995, 1997 and 2016. This is general knowledge; I did not re-verify it in this session.
- Rough benchmark (my arithmetic, not a forecast): if the 70% chance of reaching the World Series is multiplied by about a 40-45% chance of beating Milwaukee (the market-implied underdog figure), the result lands near the market prices in section 5.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Sportsbooks around Oct 16-17, after the NLCS sweep:
  - DraftKings: Brewers -170, Guardians +330 (about 23% implied, with vig), Rays +475. [SI](https://www.si.com/betting/world-series-odds-brewers-set-as-odds-on-favorites-after-sweeping-dodgers-01m52kz736d4)
  - FanDuel: Brewers -190, Guardians +340, Rays +540. [TheLines](https://www.thelines.com/mlb/news/brewers-are-the-favorites-in-the-world-series/)
  - FanDuel (another listing): Brewers -175, Guardians +340, Rays +490. [Bleacher Report](https://bleacherreport.com/articles/25512007-world-series-2026-full-schedule-and-predictions-lcs-bracket-action)
- Another SI piece said Cleveland was favored over Tampa Bay to win the AL pennant. [SI](https://www.si.com/betting/2026-world-series-odds-brewers-jump-to-favorite-guardians-favored-over-rays-in-al)
- Polymarket: the only snapshot I found is from a third-party tracker, showing Cleveland near 4¢ in late May 2026. I could not find a price from close to Oct 17. [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/mlb-world-series-champion-2026-cleveland-guardians-polymarket-0x67a229c77a)
- Kalshi and Manifold: I could not find current prices for either.
- Preseason: DraftKings had Cleveland at +3000. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/mlb/news/2026-world-series-odds)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-10-17 (Sat): ALCS Game 4 in Cleveland, rescheduled from Friday.
- 2026-10-18 (Sun): ALCS Game 5 in Cleveland, about 5 p.m. ET.
- 2026-10-19 (Mon): ALCS Game 6 at Tampa Bay, if needed, about 8 p.m. ET. A Game 7 would follow if needed.
- After that, the World Series against Milwaukee, if Cleveland advances. It would run past the stated resolution date of about Oct 20, so a "Yes" could not be confirmed that early. A "No" could come during the ALCS if Cleveland is eliminated.
- Factors to watch: Game 4 starters after the rain delay, whether Cleveland can keep holding down the Rays' strikeout-prone lineup, and travel back to Tampa Bay for Games 6 and 7.
